content_text: In anticipation of tomorrow’s IPO, we have spent the last 3 months putting together an Anthropic deep dive. We’ve sought to answer many questions including: - Who controls Anthropic after it lists? - How does Anthropic plan to outgrow its $900 billion computing bill? - Why did people who thought AI could end in catastrophe build one of the fastest-growing companies ever?
